items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I was playing with a band... This boy... Chris. A little bit of short fellow, Chris. He was on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Just a couple of years before he died. I got to playing. Charlie McCoyty was playing a band. I was playing with a band. Ronald McNeil was playing violin. Martin was playing trumpet. Charlie McCoyty was playing alto and clarinet. I was playing clarinet and soprano. Piano player, Helen Edwards was playing piano. This boy, that's how you call him again, drummer. Chris. A little bit of short fellow, Chris. He was on drums.
About what year was that? Do you remember?
